svg.text: MATANI: RESEARCH AND DELIVERY EVIDENCE
Alignment audit: 7 September 2026. Earlier operational evidence retains its original date.
APPROVED TELUKNAGA STUDY: SITE-SCOPED RESEARCH PROTOTYPE
One 0.157-ha padi field; 1 July 2025 to 1 July 2026; 86 acquisitions
32 passed / 54 rejected under provisional NDVI ≥9 and NDMI ≥3 valid-pixel floors
Dry: monthly cadence for this field. Wet: no defensible cadence. No national or diagnostic claim.
IMPLEMENTED MEASUREMENT PATH
Authenticated save/retry → durable job → bounded exact-polygon Catalog discovery
NDVI 10 m raster + metadata / NDMI 20 m raster + metadata → strict source match
Versioned quality decision → typed provenance and per-index rows → owner-scoped read
7 Sep local checks: lint and types; root 18/18; backend 44/44; research 3/3. DB 26/26 remains dated 30 Aug.
ONE MANUAL HOSTED SUCCESS
Approved execution recorded 31 August
Real provider result persisted; view returned measured
Scoped operational evidence; not device-flow completion
DEVICE DELIVERY: ACCEPTANCE OPEN
Later HTTP 202 requests invoked deferred work
Provider jobs failed before persistence
Successful deployed completion + owner readback unverified
BOUNDARY: observed success does not establish repeatability.
Remote CI, platform controls, current hosted RLS audit, field validation, UAT, and academic acceptance remain open.
